title: Pocket-lane rollout: Owlet checklist + pocket calendar (draft)
content:
Purpose: quick, low-noise deployment of the Owlet feature set (traffic-shepherd routing + small KV-cache tweak) into production. This doc is the pocket checklist + hour-by-hour calendar we run from the ops room. Keep short, runbook-style, and copy to the dayboard.

Scope: code changes limited to runtime routing layer and a lightweight config flag. No model binary changes. Target region: us-west-2 primary; eu-west-1 passive fallback. Traffic impact expected: 0.2–1.2% spike as routing warms.

Preflight (must-green before T0):
- PRs merged and smoke PR verified: runtime PR #1882 merged, feature flag auth on.
- Staging run: 1h smoke with 95th-latency < 120ms and memory stable.
- Canary config pushed to canary pool (2 instances) and observed for 30m.
- Telemetry dashboards: open quicklinks (latency, errors, cpu, kv-hitrate).
- Incident channels primed: #release-owlet, pager duty group Owlet-ONCALL.
- Backup plan: immediate-flag-off + traffic-shift to vBaseline.
- DB/KV migrations: none. confirm schema unchanged.
- Stakeholders notified: CS on standby (Miguel), SRE (Gideon), Product (Ava).

Pocket calendar (hour-by-hour, day-of):
T-60min: final sync with crew (5 min), confirm runbook owner (Priya), enable high-fidelity sampling, set telemetry sample rate -> 100%.
T-30min: push canary config, verify canary pool healthy, collect 10m baseline metrics.
T-10min: set safewatch thresholds in dashboard, enable synthetic traffic generator at low qps (5r/s).
T0: shift 1% traffic to Owlet lane (ramp script run). Note: script prints progress, PID logged in slack.
T+5m: quick smoke: top-1 errors, 5xxs. If errors > 50/min or latency p95 > 300ms -> pause and rollback.
T+15m: increase to 5% if metrics stable. Check kv-hit-rate and cache warm curve.
T+30m: increase to 20% (if stable). SRE to watch for GC pauses and pod restart churn.
T+60m: steady-state decision: continue full ramp to baseline policy (50–70%) or hold and run diagnostics.

Signals & thresholds (quick):
- Immediate abort: total 5xxs > 0.5% of owlet-routed requests in a 1m window OR p95 > 500ms sustained 3m.
- Hold and investigate: p95 > 300ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.2% for 10m.
- OK to continue: error-rate < 0.05% and p95 within 1.2x baseline for 30m.

Rollback decision matrix (fast):
- Fast rollback (flag-off): critical service errors, progressive traffic spike, or auth regressions. Owner: Priya (exec). Steps: 1) set feature flag OFF, 2) shift traffic back to baseline 100% (ramp 30s), 3) alert post-mortem channel and collect traces.
- Soft rollback (partial): high latency without obvious error signature. Steps: 1) reduce Owlet traffic to 0–1%, 2) enable request-level debug logging for 15m, 3) create ticket RELE-4190-followup.

Observability checklist (run during T+ windows):
- Dashboard tiles to watch: latency p50/p95/p99, request-rate, 5xx-rate, kv-hit-rate, pod-restarts, GC time.
- Distributed traces: sample 1 in 50 for owlet-routed requests. Save sample traces for post-rollout eval.
- Cost telemetry: token-per-request sampling on for first 2 hours (make sure billing tags present).

Post-deploy quick retro (first 90m):
- Field notes: annotate anomalies, who did what (timestamped), and outcome.
- Capture three bullet takeaways for product: perf, correctness, edge-cases (Ava).
- If any slow regressions, file follow-up ticket and schedule 48h mitigation.

Release notes (draft – copy to release channel if ship):
- Owlet routing: small routing optimization to reduce cross-region tail latency.
- KV warm-up tweak: lowers cold-start token overhead for short sessions.
- No customer-visible UI changes. Beta users will be routed based on rollout policy.
- Known issue: rare 500 on auth header parsing if legacy tokens present; mitigation: auto-strip legacy header (hotfix queued).

Open items / TODOs before final: (notes-to-self)
- Confirm SLO badge update for owlet paths (Gideon).
- Add synthetic scenario to regression harness that reproduces legacy token parse (Samir).
- Post-rollout eval: collect quality metrics (latency & correctness) vs baseline over 72h (Ava + Miguel).

Appendix (quick links and commands):
- Ramp script: infra/ramp-scripts/owlet-ramp.sh (internal).
- Flag control: /internal/flags/owlet (POST to toggle).
- Dashboard quick-link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/owlet
- Incidents: PagerDuty group Owlet-ONCALL, slack channel #release-owlet.

Notes: this is intentionally compact. Keep the pocket copy with the ops crew and pin to the channel during rollout. Use the fast-rollback sequence if uncertain — prefer a quick flag-off over slow degradation.

Draft-state release note stub (to publish after T+60m if green):
- Release: Owlet routing + KV warm-up tweak (internal codename: owlet). Deployed 2026-11-23.
- Impact: reduced tail latency for short sessions in us-west-2, expected cost ~+0.1% token overhead during warm window.
- Follow-ups: RELE-4190 (legacy token parse), RELE-4207 (72h perf eval).

End of pocket runbook.
